title: Initial address state
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet, the initial address state consists of two copies of the initial state $sInit(N)$, head position $0$, and a tape of length $hH(N)+3k$ whose entries are all $(\mathrm{false},\mathrm{false})$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define or describe $sInit$, so its meaning cannot be rendered more specifically.
